module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Lint
      # The safe navigation operator returns nil if the receiver is
      # nil. If you chain an ordinary method call after a safe
      # navigation operator, it raises NoMethodError. We should use a
      # safe navigation operator after a safe navigation operator.
      # This cop checks for the problem outlined above.
      #
      # @example
      #
      #   # bad
      #   x&.foo.bar
      #   x&.foo + bar
      #   x&.foo[bar]
      #
      #   # good
      #   x&.foo&.bar
      #   x&.foo || bar
      class SafeNavigationChain < Base
        include NilMethods
        extend AutoCorrector
        extend TargetRubyVersion

        minimum_target_ruby_version 2.3

        MSG = 'Do not chain ordinary method call after safe navigation operator.'
        PLUS_MINUS_METHODS = %i[+@ -@].freeze
        STYLE_LOGIC_JUMP_KEYWORDS = %i[break fail next raise return throw yield].freeze
        REDUNDANT_MSG = 'Redundant safe navigation detected, use `.` instead.'
        REDUNDANT_MSG_LITERAL = 'Redundant safe navigation with default literal detected.'
        NIL_SPECIFIC_METHODS = (nil.methods - Object.new.methods).to_set.freeze
        SNAKE_CASE = /\A[[:digit:][:upper:]_]+\z/.freeze
        USE_DOT_MSG = 'Use `.` instead of unnecessary `&.`.'
        USE_SAFE_NAVIGATION_MSG = 'Use `&.` for consistency with safe navigation.'
        EMPTY_NAV_MSG = 'Avoid calling `empty?` with the safe navigation operator in conditionals.'
        CHAIN_LENGTH_MSG = 'Avoid safe navigation chains longer than %<max>d calls.'
        OPERATOR_CALL_MSG = 'Redundant dot detected.'
        OPERATOR_INVALID_ARG_TYPES = %i[
          splat kwsplat forwarded_args forwarded_restarg forwarded_kwrestarg block_pass
        ].freeze
        OMIT_PARENS_MSG = 'Omit parentheses for method calls with arguments.'
        REQUIRE_PARENS_MSG = 'Use parentheses for method calls with arguments.'
        WITHOUT_PARENS_MSG = 'Do not use parentheses for method calls with no arguments.'
        SPACE_DOT_MSG = 'Avoid using spaces around a method call operator.'
        SPACES_REGEXP = /\A[ \t]+\z/.freeze
        TRAILING_WHITESPACE_REGEX = /\s+\Z/.freeze
        AMBIGUOUS_MSG_FORMAT = 'Ambiguous %<actual>s operator. Parenthesize the method ' \
                               "arguments if it's surely a %<actual>s operator, or add " \
                               'a whitespace to the right of the `%<operator>s` if it ' \
                               'should be %<possible>s.'
        AMBIGUITIES = {
          '+' => { actual: 'positive number', possible: 'an addition', operator: '+' },
          '-' => { actual: 'negative number', possible: 'a subtraction', operator: '-' },
          '*' => { actual: 'splat', possible: 'a multiplication', operator: '*' },
          '&' => { actual: 'block', possible: 'a binary AND', operator: '&' },
          '**' => { actual: 'keyword splat', possible: 'an exponent', operator: '**' }
        }.freeze
        PRECEDENCE_GROUPS = [
          %i[**],
          %i[* / %],
          %i[+ -],
          %i[<< >>],
          %i[&],
          %i[| ^],
          %i[&&],
          %i[||]
        ].freeze
        PRECEDENCE_OPERATORS = PRECEDENCE_GROUPS.flatten.freeze
        PRECEDENCE_MSG = 'Wrap expressions with varying precedence with parentheses to avoid ambiguity.'

        # @!method bad_method?(node)
        def_node_matcher :bad_method?, <<~PATTERN
          {
            (send $(csend ...) $_ ...)
            (send $({block numblock} (csend ...) ...) $_ ...)
          }
        PATTERN

        # @!method style_modifier_if_candidate(node)
        def_node_matcher :style_modifier_if_candidate, <<~PATTERN
          {
            (if {
                  (send $_ {:nil? :!})
                  $_
                } nil? $_)

            (if {
                  (send (send $_ :nil?) :!)
                  $_
                } $_ nil?)
          }
        PATTERN

        # @!method style_ternary_candidate(node)
        def_node_matcher :style_ternary_candidate, <<~PATTERN
          {
            (if (send $_ {:nil? :!}) nil $_)

            (if (send (send $_ :nil?) :!) $_ nil)

            (if $_ $_ nil)
          }
        PATTERN

        # @!method style_and_with_rhs_or?(node)
        def_node_matcher :style_and_with_rhs_or?, '(and _ {or (begin or)})'

        # @!method style_not_nil_check?(node)
        def_node_matcher :style_not_nil_check?, '(send (send $_ :nil?) :!)'

        # @!method style_and_inside_begin?(node)
        def_node_matcher :style_and_inside_begin?, '`(begin and ...)'

        # @!method style_strip_begin(node)
        def_node_matcher :style_strip_begin, '{ (begin $!begin) $!(begin) }'

        # @!method redundant_respond_to_nil_specific_method?(node)
        def_node_matcher :redundant_respond_to_nil_specific_method?, <<~PATTERN
          (csend _ :respond_to? (sym %NIL_SPECIFIC_METHODS))
        PATTERN

        # @!method redundant_conversion_with_default?(node)
        def_node_matcher :redundant_conversion_with_default?, <<~PATTERN
          {
            (or $(csend _ :to_h) (hash))
            (or (block $(csend _ :to_h) ...) (hash))
            (or $(csend _ :to_a) (array))
            (or $(csend _ :to_i) (int 0))
            (or $(csend _ :to_f) (float 0.0))
            (or $(csend _ :to_s) (str empty?))
          }
        PATTERN

        # @!method empty_nav_in_conditional?(node)
        def_node_matcher :empty_nav_in_conditional?, <<~PATTERN
          (if (csend (send ...) :empty?) ...)
        PATTERN

        def on_send(node)
          @nav_send = node
          return unless require_safe_navigation?(node)

          bad_method?(node) do |safe_nav, method|
            return if nil_methods.include?(method) || PLUS_MINUS_METHODS.include?(node.method_name)

            begin_range = node.loc.dot || safe_nav.source_range.end
            location = begin_range.join(node.source_range.end)

            add_offense(location) do |corrector|
              autocorrect(corrector, offense_range: location, send_node: node)
            end
          end
        end

        def run_style_if(host, node)
          @style_host = host
          @style_node = node
          @style_chain = node
          return if style_allowed_if_condition?(node)

          checked_variable, receiver, method_chain, _method = style_extract_parts_from_if(node)
          return unless style_offending_node?(node, checked_variable, method_chain, receiver)

          body = style_extract_if_body(node)
          method_call = receiver.parent
          removal_ranges = [style_begin_range(node, body), style_end_range(node, body)]

          style_report_offense(node, method_chain, method_call, *removal_ranges) do |corrector|
            corrector.insert_before(method_call.loc.dot, '&') unless method_call.safe_navigation?
          end
        end

        def run_style_and(host, node)
          @style_host = host
          @style_node = node
          @style_chain = node
          style_collect_and_clauses(node).each do |(lhs, lhs_operator_range), (rhs, _rhs_operator_range)|
            lhs_not_nil_check = style_not_nil_check?(lhs)
            lhs_receiver = lhs_not_nil_check || lhs
            rhs_receiver = style_find_matching_receiver_invocation(style_strip_begin(rhs), lhs_receiver)

            next if !@style_host.send(:cop_config)['ConvertCodeThatCanStartToReturnNil'] && lhs_not_nil_check
            next unless style_offending_node?(node, lhs_receiver, rhs, rhs_receiver)

            lhs_method_chain = style_find_method_chain(lhs_receiver)
            next unless lhs_method_chain == lhs_receiver || lhs_not_nil_check

            style_report_offense(
              node,
              rhs, rhs_receiver,
              @style_host.send(:range_with_surrounding_space, range: lhs.source_range, side: :right),
              @style_host.send(:range_with_surrounding_space, range: lhs_operator_range, side: :right),
              offense_range: @style_host.send(:range_between, lhs.source_range.begin_pos, rhs.source_range.end_pos)
            )
          end
        end

        def run_consistency_and(host, node)
          @consistency_host = host
          @consistency_node = node
          @consistency_operands = []
          all_operands = consistency_collect_operands(node, [])
          operand_groups = all_operands.group_by { |operand| consistency_receiver_name_as_key(operand, +'') }

          operand_groups.each_value do |grouped_operands|
            next unless (dot_op, begin_of_rest_operands = consistency_find_consistent_parts(grouped_operands))

            rest_operands = grouped_operands[begin_of_rest_operands..]

              next if consistency_already_appropriate_call?(operand, dot_op)

              consistency_register_offense(operand, dot_op)
            end
          end
